content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Rohini Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Rohini recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for medical posts is scheduled for 08 September 2026, and for dental posts, it is on 09 September 2026. Candidates should report between 09:00 to 11:00 AM for registration.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC Rohini?
faq.answer: ESIC Rohini has announced a total of 19 vacancies for the posts of Associate Professor and Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The required qualification is as per NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualification Regulations 2022 and DCI BDS/MDS Regulations 2007.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 67 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor and Associate Professor positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Assistant Professor is ₹1,50,294/- per month, and for Associate Professor, it is ₹1,74,936/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Rohini recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500/- for General/OBC candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are filled through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report at the specified venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Employee State Insurance Corporation Dental College & Hospital, Rohini, Delhi - 110089.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. However, the maximum age limit is 67 years for all posts.
